description: This PHP source file defines the JobCategoryController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the pre-rendering process by setting a Vue component named 'job-category-list'. It is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for handling job category related views in the admin interface.

classes.name: JobCategoryController
classes.description: Controller for handling job category views in the HRM admin plugin, extends the abstract Vue controller and sets up the 'job-category-list' component during pre-render.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets the Vue component to 'job-category-list' before rendering the view.
